title: AOF 追加：appendfsync always 耐久性
expected_output:
appendfsync always:
  崩溃前已 fsync 命令数: 3
  AOF 重放后恢复数据: {'a': 1, 'b': 2, 'c': 3}
  耐久性: 每次写都落盘, 进程崩溃也几乎无丢失; 代价: 每次写一次 fsync, 吞吐最低
code:
def aof_always(writes, crash_after):
    aof = []
    fsyncs = 0
    for i, w in enumerate(writes):
        aof.append(w)
        fsyncs += 1  # always: 每次写命令都 fsync
        if i + 1 == crash_after:
            break
    return aof, fsyncs

writes = [("SET", "a", 1), ("SET", "b", 2), ("SET", "c", 3)]
aof, f = aof_always(writes, crash_after=3)
print("appendfsync always:")
print("  崩溃前已 fsync 命令数:", f)
print("  AOF 重放后恢复数据:", {k: v for _, k, v in aof})
print("  耐久性: 每次写都落盘, 进程崩溃也几乎无丢失; 代价: 每次写一次 fsync, 吞吐最低")
